ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure has a circle, and all three vertices of the triangle are on the circle. A right-angle symbol is marked at a vertex of the triangle, indicating that this angle is 90°. The two slanted sides starting from the vertex have identical pink tick marks, indicating that these two sides are equal. The left side is labeled 6√2 ft. The base of the triangle passes through the center of the circle, connecting the left and right points on the circle. Then reason: The two equal sides intersect at the 90° angle, so this triangle is an isosceles right triangle, that is, a 45-45-90 triangle. The two legs are equal, and one of them is 6√2 ft, so both legs are 6√2 ft. The hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle equals a leg multiplied by √2, so the hypotenuse is (6√2)(√2)=12 ft. Because this is a right triangle inscribed in a circle, the side opposite the right angle is the diameter of the circle; the base in the figure also passes through the center of the circle, confirming that it is the diameter. Therefore the diameter of the circle is d=12 ft, and the circumference of the circle is C=πd=12π ft.

raw_record.question_text: A triangle is inscribed in a circle. Find the exact circumference of the circle.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as an inscribed triangle whose top angle is marked 90 degrees, whose two slanted sides from the top vertex have matching tick marks, and whose left slanted side is labeled 6√2 ft. Since the two legs meeting at the right angle are congruent, the triangle is a 45-45-90 right triangle with each leg 6√2 ft. Use the 45-45-90 ratio to get the hypotenuse: (6√2)(√2)=12 ft. The hypotenuse is the side opposite the right angle and is drawn through the circle’s center, so it is the circle’s diameter. Then compute circumference C=πd=12π.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有一个圆，三角形的三个顶点都在圆上。三角形顶点处标有直角符号，表示该角为90°。从顶点出发的两条斜边上有相同的粉色刻痕，表示这两条边相等。左侧这条边被标注为6√2 ft。三角形底边经过圆心，连接圆上左右两个点。

再推理：两条相等的边在90°角处相交，所以该三角形是等腰直角三角形，即45-45-90三角形。两条直角边相等，且其中一条为6√2 ft，因此两条直角边都是6√2 ft。45-45-90三角形的斜边等于直角边乘以√2，所以斜边为(6√2)(√2)=12 ft。因为这是圆内接直角三角形，直角所对的边是圆的直径；图中底边也经过圆心，确认它是直径。因此圆的直径d=12 ft，圆周长C=πd=12π ft。
